easy: A sweet, sticky spread made from fruit cooked with sugar.

ex.en: I spread strawberry jam on my toast.

easy: An animal like a big mouse with a long tail.

ex.en: A rat ran across the kitchen floor.
ex.ko: 쥐 한 마리가 부엌 바닥을 가로질러 달렸다.

easy: Being very sure about what you want to do and not giving up.

ex.en: Her strong resolve helped her finish the race.
ex.ko: 그녀의 굳은 결심이 달리기를 끝까지 마치게 도와주었다.

easy: The bright light that comes from something.

ex.en: The shine of the moon lit up the lake.

easy: A person or thing that takes the place of another.

ex.en: Our teacher was sick, so we had a substitute today.
ex.ko: 선생님이 아프셔서 오늘은 대체 선생님이 오셨다.

easy: To use one thing in place of another.

ex.en: You can substitute honey for sugar.
ex.ko: 설탕 대신 꿀을 쓸 수 있다.

easy: A short, high sound that a small bird makes.

ex.en: We heard the tweet of a bird outside.
ex.ko: 밖에서 새가 짹짹 우는 소리가 들렸다.

easy: A thin, round ball of air inside a liquid or soap.

ex.en: I blew a big soap bubble.

easy: To hit something again and again with a hammer.

ex.en: Dad hammered a nail into the board.

easy: The very first time people can see a new movie or play.

ex.en: We went to the premiere of the new cartoon movie.
ex.ko: 우리는 새 만화영화의 개봉 행사에 갔다.

easy: To block the sun and make a dark place on the ground.

ex.en: Big trees shade our playground.
ex.ko: 큰 나무들이 우리 놀이터에 그늘을 만들어 준다.

easy: Having to do with Wales, a country in the United Kingdom, or its people.

ex.en: We saw sheep on the Welsh hills.

easy: Something you think about in your mind that you cannot touch or see.

ex.en: Love is an abstract idea, so you cannot touch it.
ex.ko: 사랑은 추상적인 생각이라서 만질 수 없다.

easy: Making people follow it because of a law or a promise.

ex.en: A signed contract is binding, so you must keep your promise.
ex.ko: 서명한 계약은 구속력이 있어서 약속을 지켜야 한다.

easy: To scare someone so much that they do what you want.

ex.en: The loud thunder cowed the puppy, and it hid under the bed.
ex.ko: 큰 천둥소리에 강아지가 겁을 먹고 침대 밑에 숨었다.

easy: To move or go very fast.

ex.en: We hurried to catch the school bus.

easy: To give a talk to a group to teach them about something.

ex.en: A scientist lectured to our class about space.
ex.ko: 한 과학자가 우리 반에 우주에 대해 강연했다.

easy: In the direction between north and west.

ex.en: The geese flew northwest.

easy: To put pepper on food.

ex.en: Mom peppered the soup.

easy: To put things on top of each other in a stack.

ex.en: We piled the books on the desk.

easy: To fill a hole so nothing can get through.

ex.en: I plugged the hole in the bucket with clay.

easy: To have water come out of your skin when you are hot.

ex.en: I sweat a lot when I run.

easy: To put an animal in a cage.

ex.en: At night, we cage our pet bird.
ex.ko: 밤에 우리는 애완 새를 새장에 넣는다.

easy: To act in a way that is too big and silly on stage.

ex.en: He hammed it up in the school play.

easy: To hit something with a quick, short knock.

ex.en: She rapped on the door.

easy: To do something very well and easily.

ex.en: I aced my spelling test.
ex.ko: 나는 맞춤법 시험을 만점으로 잘 봤다.

easy: Happening every second time, skipping one in between.

ex.en: We have gym on alternate days.
ex.ko: 우리는 하루 걸러 체육 수업이 있다.

easy: To make a steady beat sound.

ex.en: Rain drummed on the roof.

easy: To hold something tight.

ex.en: I gripped the rope with both hands.
ex.ko: 나는 두 손으로 밧줄을 꽉 잡았다.

easy: Made by mixing two different kinds of plants or animals.

ex.en: A mule is a hybrid of a horse and a donkey.

easy: A person who makes bowls and pots out of clay.

ex.en: The potter shaped a bowl on the wheel.

easy: To puff out and get round and big.

ex.en: The sail bellied out in the wind.

easy: The feeling you have when you need food.

ex.en: Hunger made my stomach growl.

easy: A tool that spins quickly to make holes.

ex.en: Dad used a drill to make a hole in the wall.

easy: To secretly tell news that was supposed to be a secret.

ex.en: Someone leaked the surprise party plan to my sister.
ex.ko: 누군가 깜짝 파티 계획을 언니에게 흘렸다.

easy: A yellow-green color like an olive.

ex.en: She wore an olive green jacket.

easy: To make someone feel better when they are sad.

ex.en: I consoled my little brother when he lost his toy.

easy: To bend something so one part lies on top of another.

ex.en: Fold the paper in half.

easy: To stay somewhere for a short time.

ex.en: We lodged in a cabin near the lake.

easy: To become white in the face, like when you are scared.

ex.en: He paled when he saw the huge spider.
ex.ko: 그는 커다란 거미를 보고 얼굴이 창백해졌다.

easy: Something that can make you very sick if you eat or drink it.

ex.en: Some mushrooms have poison in them.

easy: To ring a bell slowly.

ex.en: The church bell tolled twelve times.
ex.ko: 교회 종이 열두 번 천천히 울렸다.

easy: To cover something all over, like a blanket does.

ex.en: Snow blanketed the playground.

easy: To flow slowly out of a place.

ex.en: The bathtub water drained away.

easy: The hot, bright light you see when something burns.

ex.en: The candle flame danced in the wind.

easy: To tell something in a small way without saying it out loud.

ex.en: Mom hinted that we might get ice cream.
ex.ko: 엄마는 아이스크림을 먹을지도 모른다고 넌지시 말했다.

easy: Colored liquid used for writing, drawing, or printing.

ex.en: My pen ran out of ink.

easy: To rule a country as a king or queen.

ex.en: The queen reigned for fifty years.

easy: To reach across a place or a time.

ex.en: A long bridge spans the river.

easy: One of the five small parts at the end of your foot.

ex.en: I stubbed my toe on the chair.

easy: To trick someone and take something from them.

ex.en: The seller cheated him out of ten dollars.

easy: A loud shout of joy or support.

ex.en: The crowd gave a big cheer when we scored.
ex.ko: 우리가 점수를 내자 관중이 크게 환호했다.

easy: Packed tightly together and hard.

ex.en: After the rain, the dirt path was hard and compact.
ex.ko: 비가 온 뒤 흙길은 단단하게 다져져 있었다.

easy: Having many small, fancy details.

ex.en: She drew an elaborate castle with tiny windows.
ex.ko: 그녀는 작은 창문이 있는 정교한 성을 그렸다.

easy: In the middle between two places.

ex.en: We stopped halfway up the hill.

easy: A low humming sound, like the one a bee makes.

ex.en: We heard the buzz of a bee near the flowers.
ex.ko: 꽃 근처에서 벌이 윙윙거리는 소리가 들렸다.

easy: A low spot in the ground or road.

ex.en: Our bike hit a dip in the road.
ex.ko: 우리 자전거가 도로의 움푹 팬 곳을 지났다.

easy: A very small round mark.

ex.en: The ladybug has black dots on its back.

easy: To show numbers as a picture with lines or bars.

ex.en: We graphed how tall our plants grew.
ex.ko: 우리는 식물이 얼마나 자랐는지 그래프로 나타냈다.

easy: To cut something by swinging a tool at it again and again.

ex.en: He hacked through the weeds with a big tool.
ex.ko: 그는 큰 도구로 잡초를 베며 길을 냈다.

easy: The middle number in a list of numbers.

ex.en: The median of 1, 3, and 9 is 3.

easy: To load a place with piles of things.

ex.en: The workers stacked the truck with boxes.

easy: A crackling noise you hear on a radio or TV.

ex.en: The radio was full of static during the storm.

easy: To add a taste to food.

ex.en: Dad flavors his soup with garlic.

easy: To draw something quickly with simple lines.

ex.en: I sketched the old tree in my notebook.

easy: A stream of warm air that goes up into the sky.

ex.en: The hawk rode a thermal high into the sky.
ex.ko: 매는 상승 기류를 타고 하늘 높이 올랐다.

easy: Something that is thrown out because it is not good enough.

ex.en: At the bakery, the broken cookies were rejects.

easy: To add something extra because there is not enough.

ex.en: Mom supplements our dinner with fresh fruit.
ex.ko: 엄마는 우리 저녁 식사에 신선한 과일을 보충해 준다.

easy: How well something springs back after it hits the ground.

ex.en: This new ball has a lot of bounce.
ex.ko: 이 새 공은 탄력이 아주 좋다.

easy: A boat that carries people and cars across water.

ex.en: We rode the ferry to the island.

easy: A tool that measures something and shows how much there is.

ex.en: The gas gauge shows the car is almost empty.
ex.ko: 연료 계기판을 보니 차에 기름이 거의 없다.

easy: To give birth to a baby sheep.

ex.en: Our sheep lambed in the barn last night.
ex.ko: 우리 양이 어젯밤 헛간에서 새끼 양을 낳았다.

easy: To put something into something else.

ex.en: Insert the coin into the slot.

easy: A big piece of cloth on a boat that catches the wind.

ex.en: The wind filled the sail.

easy: A light yellow-brown color.

ex.en: My puppy has soft tan fur.
ex.ko: 내 강아지는 부드러운 황갈색 털을 가졌다.

easy: To make a low, dull sound that goes on and on.

ex.en: The fan droned all night.

easy: To go with someone to keep them safe or show the way.

ex.en: Dad escorted me to my classroom.

easy: To pull or move suddenly and hard.

ex.en: I jerked my hand back from the hot stove.
ex.ko: 나는 뜨거운 난로에서 손을 홱 뺐다.

easy: To cut cleanly through something.

ex.en: I sliced the apple into four pieces.

easy: Wanting very much to do something and not changing your mind.

ex.en: She was bent on winning the spelling bee.
ex.ko: 그녀는 철자 대회에서 우승하기로 굳게 마음먹었다.

easy: To bring a ship to the place where it is tied up.

ex.en: The ship docked at the port.

easy: To make up for something with something else.

ex.en: The cool breeze offset the heat of the day.
ex.ko: 시원한 바람이 낮의 더위를 상쇄해 주었다.

easy: A round, swollen lump on your body after you hit it.

ex.en: I got a bump on my head when I fell.

easy: The bone at the bottom of your face that holds your teeth.

ex.en: My jaw hurts from chewing gum.

easy: To bother someone by teasing them again and again.

ex.en: My brother needles me about my haircut.
ex.ko: 오빠는 내 머리 모양을 두고 계속 약을 올린다.

easy: To feel sad for someone who is hurting.

ex.en: I pity the puppy left out in the rain.
ex.ko: 나는 비를 맞고 있는 강아지가 불쌍하다.

easy: To warn someone strongly about a danger.

ex.en: The lifeguard cautioned us not to swim far.
ex.ko: 안전요원은 멀리 헤엄치지 말라고 주의를 주었다.

easy: A feeling of great happiness.

ex.en: She squealed with delight when she saw the puppy.
ex.ko: 그녀는 강아지를 보고 기뻐서 소리를 질렀다.

easy: To look around a place to find something or someone.

ex.en: We scouted the woods for a good campsite.
ex.ko: 우리는 좋은 야영지를 찾으려고 숲을 살펴보았다.
